summary: Every public address of the install is checked for Microsoft's sign-in, and the old sign-in front is gone.

fixes.title: Every public address checked for sign-in
fixes.text: Each update run now checks every address of your installation that the internet can reach, and reports any that is not behind Microsoft's sign-in.

fixes.title: The old sign-in front is removed
fixes.text: The release no longer carries the earlier sign-in front. Your web app already uses Microsoft's built-in sign-in.
